method.total: Ordinary p50 of all eligible native aggregate decode gauges, sampled approximately every 2 seconds.
method.per_task: For each same-window sample divide aggregate rate by actual active task count C, then take p50. This is the time-sampled median of concurrent per-task average throughput, not a cross-request distribution median.
method.selection: Same monitor generation and exact benchmark cell lifetime counter bounds; online valid dt; current and previous observed C equal target C. Entire trailing native 2-second gauge window must be inside an already streaming model reply of EVERY task, plus 0.5s on both boundaries.
method.excluded: Prefill/startup, tool gaps crossing a gauge window, idle time and lower-concurrency completion tails. No selection by speed and no faster-half/top-window cherry-picking.
method.coverage: A single archived run, limited valid full-concurrency intervals. These are sampled rolling native rates, not isolated GPU kernel timing or end-to-end workflow TPS.
method.read_only: No inference, production changes, restarts or benchmark reruns. Raw benchmark files remain unchanged.
